notes.umap: The two projections are separate, independent fits with identical hyperparameters and the same seed. Structure is comparable between them; absolute positions are NOT. A point at (0.2, 0.7) in the MAE map has no relationship to (0.2, 0.7) in the I-JEPA map.
notes.neighbors: Top-8 by cosine similarity in the full 384-dimensional embedding space, self excluded. Not derived from the 2D coordinates.
notes.pooling: Global average pool over all patch tokens. No CLS token, both branches.
notes.labels: Never used during pretraining. Both encoders pretrain on the 100,000 unlabeled STL-10 images; labels enter only at probe/eval time.
